layers.mechanism: volatility persists session to session; the combined expected-range multiplier is known at the prior close

layers.edges: first close beyond the 09:30-10:00 range, 10:00-11:30 ET
layers.mechanism: participants keyed to the opening range act on a close beyond it

interaction_claim: the context layer changes what the break MEANS (continuation on a day with room to travel, range-edge on a day without), rather than filtering out losing trades
outcome: realised R to the first of target / stop / 15:55 time exit
exit: stop at the opposite side of the opening range, target 1.0x range width, time exit 15:55 ET; a bar spanning both resolves to the stop
cost_model: frozen B3 placeholder mechanics; costs are not netted into R because the GATING number is a DIFFERENCE between two cells of the same entry, where per-trade cost cancels
mde: SE of the difference ~0.14R at n=100 per cell (sd~1.0R); smallest resolvable difference ~0.23R at 90% before multiplicity, more after
